name: ribbons-tauri
description: Famous Ribbons Screensaver made with js and Tauri (Rust) wrapped for multi platform support
author: Yuri Samoilov <root@drlight.fun>

scripts.build: tauri build && node scripts/rename-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/latest-json.mjs
scripts.build-AppImage: tauri build --bundles appimage && node scripts/rename-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/latest-json.mjs
scripts.build-targz: npm run block && tauri build --no-bundle && node scripts/archive.mjs targz && npm run unblock
scripts.build-exe: tauri build --bundles nsis && node scripts/rename-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/latest-json.mjs
scripts.build-msi: npm run block && tauri build --bundles msi && node scripts/rename-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/latest-json.mjs && npm run unblock
scripts.build-zip: npm run block && tauri build --no-bundle && node scripts/archive.mjs zip && npm run unblock
scripts.build-zip-mac: npm run block && tauri build --bundles app && node scripts/rename-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/latest-json.mjs && node scripts/archive.mjs zip-mac && npm run unblock
scripts.build-dmg: tauri build --bundles app,dmg && node scripts/rename-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/latest-json.mjs
scripts.build-win: npm run build-zip && npm run build-msi && npm run build-exe
scripts.build-mac: npm run build-zip-mac && npm run build-dmg
scripts.build-linux: npm run build-rpm && npm run build-deb && npm run build-targz && npm run build-AppImage
